capabilities: Complete accounts, payees, narrations, commodities, tags, and links while typing
Align decimal points and format ledger transactions
Validate ledgers with bean-check on save, with error markers and quick fixes
Show an outline, a problems list, and a per-account balances table
Start and stop Fava to view the ledger in a browser
disambiguation: Not the Beancount accounting tool itself; it edits and validates Beancount ledgers stored in an Obsidian vault.
extras: Validation and Fava require Beancount/Fava installed locally on the PATH (with a setting for the full executable path, notably for macOS PATH issues); every other feature works without them. The plugin documents exactly which native programs it runs and that it never sends data over the network.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in support for editing Beancount plain-text accounting ledgers: no highlighting, completion, alignment, or validation for .bean files or beancount code fences.

relations.evidence: Start Fava runs Fava on the entry ledger and opens it in your browser

summary: Beancount ledger editing for Obsidian: syntax highlighting, completion, transaction alignment, an outline, account balances, and bean-check validation on save.
